title: Phase r18 — the cloud smoke: local rehearsal PROVEN, paid run armed and blocked on two operator gates

proven_locally.what: conductor's ENTIRE cloud chain ran unmodified against conductor-trainer:smoke serving sshd on this host with PUBLIC_KEY injected exactly as vast injects it — StartCloudRun, sshj host-key verify + pubkey auth, bundle build/upload/sha-verify, nohup entrypoint launch + 1s pid probe, stage polling through ReadCloudRemoteTelemetry (timeline parsed), StopTrackedCloudRun teardown. ONE stub: the vast HTTP seam (LocalContainerProvisioner).
proven_locally.shape: bundle DONE -> config DONE (verdict admitted train_smoke_cloud.yaml) -> train RUNNING -> train FAILED (torch.cuda: no NVIDIA driver) -> post_install stayed PENDING — the evidence gate observed end-to-end from the conductor side; teardown Stopped(ids=[1])
proven_locally.probe: conductor CloudSmokeProbe (liveTest, env-gated; conductor 31a7c50c); deterministic suite excludes it by the *Probe glob

seam_defect_found.what: conductor requires QGRE_CLOUD_SSH_HOST_KEY BEFORE launch (CloudRemoteResolver.kt:10) but the base image generates host keys at FIRST BOOT (qgre-sshd-entrypoint) — a fresh instance's fingerprint is unknowable pre-launch, so as shipped NO instance could ever pass sshj's verifier
seam_defect_found.smoke_closure: docker/Dockerfile.smoke bakes host keys at BUILD (ssh-keygen -A; -A regenerates nothing at boot) and prints the fingerprint: SHA256:qY1NodMMv+cSXlVVSWN7/0OSvEkWgPaaBwt3Zb3sCtc. TRADEOFF: anyone with the image holds the host private key -> the channel is MITM-able by an on-path attacker with the image; acceptable for a throwaway smoke, NOT production
production_fix_options: instance publishes its first-boot fingerprint through a provider-readable channel
a TOFU capture step before the auth policy hardens
per-instance keys + vast API exposure if vast ever surfaces host keys

smoke_image.config: configs/train_smoke_cloud.yaml — smoke_steps=20, fp4 + int8_master=storage (the floor), no corpus needed, save_dir unset; engine-oracle ACCEPTED

paid_run_blocked_on_operator: mint a READ-ONLY ghcr pull token (classic PAT, ONLY read:packages) and store the vast login string in the keyring: printf '%s' '-u marcospaulo -p <token> ghcr.io' | secret-tool store --label='vast image_login (ghcr read-only)' service vastai-registry

paid_run_ready.command: QGRE_PAID_SMOKE=1 QGRE_CLOUD_TRAINING_IMAGE=ghcr.io/torad-labs/conductor-trainer@sha256:0a3c5ec3ca0704b3cee1c13e818c4689a70b221819c17d8488ce8d085bb136f3 QGRE_CLOUD_REGISTRY_LOGIN="$(secret-tool lookup service vastai-registry)" QGRE_CLOUD_SSH_USER=root QGRE_CLOUD_SSH_KEY_PATH=$HOME/.ssh/qgre_cloud_smoke QGRE_CLOUD_SSH_HOST_KEY=SHA256:qY1NodMMv+cSXlVVSWN7/0OSvEkWgPaaBwt3Zb3sCtc QGRE_CLOUD_BUNDLE_FILES=<engine>/configs/train_smoke_cloud.yaml ./gradlew :conductor-agent:liveTest --tests 'ai.torad.conductor.agent.provider.CloudSmokeProbe'
paid_run_ready.expected: post_install DONE with >=1 metric rows (the paid arm asserts it), teardown + no conductor-labeled instance left billing
still_unarbitrated_until_paid: vast ssh_direct plumbing to the image's own sshd
default disk fits a 13.2GB pull (createInstance sends no disk field)
the first real fp4 training step from this image

Corrected: the image lives at ghcr.io/torad-labs/conductor-trainer:smoke (org-owned, PRIVATE, digest sha256:71f65c283063ce5b630b75d6f4e9551943cf59c9f0ef7528fb85ad00dbf020c5, blobs cross-repo mounted so no re-upload), and conductor 3b442df6 adds the image_login seam so vast authenticates its pull — the image never needs to be public

registry_correction_2026_08_01.fine_grained_linkage: re-pushed with org.opencontainers.image.source=github.com/torad-labs/conductor-app so the package is repo-linked (fine-grained PATs reach ghcr only through a linked repo); NEW digest sha256:0a3c5ec3ca0704b3cee1c13e818c4689a70b221819c17d8488ce8d085bb136f3 (label-only change, layers + host-key fingerprint unchanged)

paid_attempts_ledger_2026_08_01_02.note: every attempt tore down cleanly or was swept within minutes; total stray billing across all attempts ~cents

attempts.finding: the 12x5s ready window was sized for a warm machine, never a 13.2GB cold pull

instrumented rental: a 1.3Gbps host was STILL mid-pull at nine minutes, docker retrying blobs — ghcr throttles per-blob throughput, nominal bandwidth is not the limit; ALSO attempt-1's TITAN X was sm_52, which torch cu130 cannot run at all
attempts.fix: window -> 30min + capability floor compute_cap>=750 server+client, unknown refused (ff53d722, 556dfb34); image_login private pull PROVEN in the same rental (layers authenticated and pulled)

attempts.finding: StopIteration at build_model:434 — the int8-v2 base is a TEXT-ONLY export with zero model.language_model.* keys; model_path-only boots the multimodal remap, which is empty
attempts.fix: smoke config boots via data.init_from (the native int8-master loader); empty remap now dies with a named RuntimeError (engine fb38c988)

attempts.outcome: gradle client killed thrice by this box's memory reaper (earlyoom domain; oom-shield covers the client, not the daemon tree)
attempts.finding: the launcher process must be detachable from the operator seat
attempts.fix: runs as a systemd user unit with the host-policy caps (MemoryHigh=13G/Max=14G), --no-daemon

attempts.finding: CUDA init refused: host DRIVER was 12.6-era under a capable card — 'driver too old (found version 12060)'; the card is not the whole machine
attempts.fix: third marketplace filter cuda_max_good>=13.0 server+client, unknown refused (conductor 556dfb34+c42410a6; the latter also repairs my own red-gate push, disclosed in its message)

attempts.finding: Triton JIT-compiles its CUDA driver shim with cc/gcc at RUNTIME; the image ships only g++-14. Never seen anywhere before: Blackwell (build host) takes the real Quartet kernel, and the pseudoquant path (capability<10) had never executed until a rented Ampere card ran it
attempts.fix: image carries gcc-14 + cc/gcc names (engine 7c836fa5); rebuild+push in flight

paid_attempts_ledger_2026_08_01_02.structural_fix_from_the_push_pain: the venv is now its own image layer baked before the tree (engine 3c6e4963) — a one-line engine fix re-ships ~1GB instead of the ~8GB measured tonight
paid_attempts_ledger_2026_08_01_02.remaining_unproven: one real fp4 smoke step on rented hardware — attempt 9 fires when the gcc-fixed image push lands
